principle: Public-record availability is not the same as ethical display. Privacy class and display class are required before person-level publication.

privacy_classes.description: Agency, court, city, union, oversight body, or other institution.
Officer or public official named in official capacity in a public record.
Adult plaintiff/defendant/claimant already publicly named in litigation or public proceeding.
Civilian involved in incident but not necessarily public-facing by choice.
Minor or person who was a minor at incident time.
Survivor or complainant in sexual misconduct, domestic violence, intimate partner, or coercive sexual-contact context.
Person whose record would reveal medical, mental health, disability, or crisis-response information.
Family member or next-of-kin in death, notification, custody death, or missing-effects contexts.
Undocumented person, sex worker, informant, unhoused person, or person facing retaliation risk.

default_rule: When uncertain, use the more protective class until review.
